en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Mihran, from Abdul Azeem Bin Abdullah Al Hasanni, from Ali Bin Asbat, from Khalaf Bin Hammad, from Ibn Muskan, from Malik Al Juhny who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about the Words of Allahazwj the Exalted [19:67] Or does not the human being remember that We Created him before, when he was nothing? So heasws said: ‘Neither Measured nor Configured’.

He (the narrator) said, ‘And I asked himasws about Hisazwj Words [76:1] There surely came over the human being a period of time when he had not become a thing worthy of mention. So heasws said: ‘Ordained without being Mentioned’.
